enhanced.policy: Positive tier requires query number surplus_enhanced_{stability|handling|reload}_{1|2|3}, in stat_point, giving the complete bonus for that tier. No normal fallback and no invented +5. Tier zero returns zero.
enhanced.automatic_reload: The current reload host supplies no enhanced calibration numbers. Enhanced Surplus reloads therefore remain unsupported and fail before scheduling or transferring ammunition.

charge_count.policy: Sum full_charges from selected base grenade/melee/class accounts; floor each account separately; cap sum at 3; absent selection/cost explicitly contributes zero; exclude super.
charge_count.scope: 2020 firsthand testing with correction reports extra charges count separately up to 3. Historical support, not current verification of every exotic/subclass/shared-pool case.

consumer_fixture.timing_policy: Existing Chorus contract samples duration at acceptance; later changes affect the next request.
consumer_fixture.handling_stability: Numeric outputs only; draw/ADS/recoil presentation and timing are not implemented.
